statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // ""'); dir="${dir/#$HOME/~}"; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // ""'); sess=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); sess_seg=""; [ -n "$sess" ] && sess_seg=" | session:$(printf '%.0f' "$sess")%"; week_seg=""; [ -n "$week" ] && week_seg=" week:$(printf '%.0f' "$week")%"; branch=""; if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); fi; branch_seg=""; [ -n "$branch" ] && branch_seg=" \033[0;32m${branch}\033[0m"; printf '%b' "\033[0;34m${dir}\033[0m${branch_seg} [\033[0;36m${model}\033[0m${sess_seg}${week_seg}]"

hooks.command: L=$(ls -t .claude/ledger.md .claude/worktrees/*/.claude/ledger.md .worktrees/*/.claude/ledger.md 2>/dev/null); N=$(echo "$L" | grep -c .); if [ "$N" = 1 ]; then echo "Task ledger at $L is authoritative. Preserve its path and its Next step section verbatim."; elif [ "$N" -gt 1 ]; then echo "$N task ledgers exist (most recently modified first). Preserve the path of the ledger this session is working on, and its Next step section verbatim:"; echo "$L"; fi

L=$(ls .claude/ledger.md .claude/worktrees/*/.claude/ledger.md .worktrees/*/.claude/ledger.md 2>/dev/null); N=$(echo "$L" | grep -c .); if [ "$N" = 1 ]; then echo "A task ledger exists at $L. Contents follow. If it has open steps, continue from Next step without re-verifying finished steps."; echo; cat "$L"; elif [ "$N" -gt 1 ]; then echo "$N task ledgers exist. Summary of each follows. If asked what we are working on, answer from this. Before continuing one, ask which, then read its full ledger."; for f in $L; do echo; echo "=== $f"; awk '/^## Goal/{g=1;next} /^## Location/{g=0} /^## Next step/{n=1;next} /^## /{n=0} g||n{print}' "$f"; done; fi
